verdict.rationale: Formant documents an Admin API, a query/ingestion API and SDKs, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found 404s at every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path. The llms.txt file it does serve is a documentation index, not a machine-readable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
